A1.justification: Both complete, readable 44-page PDFs describe the same SkillFactory work. Their text, equations, 13 tables, nine figures and appendices can be matched despite the algorithm relocation, appendix renumbering and pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original model-training and evaluation results, including Countdown generalization, OpenThoughts-based experiments, budget forcing, ablations and analyses of cognitive-skill use.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Sections 5–7 and the appendices, including benchmark scores, ablations and model-output analyses.

M1.justification: The solution sampling, reflection filtering, trace construction, SFT and GRPO procedures remain unchanged, including OpenThoughts rationalization. Algorithm 1 is identical; it moves from v1 Appendix A to v2 Section 3.

E1.justification: Both retain Countdown-3arg and OpenThoughts training, with the same evaluation coverage: harder Countdown variants, Acronym, Letter Countdown, multiplication, CSQA, GSM8K, GPQA, AIME 2025, AMC and Math500. Task difficulties and represented scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: RL-only, BOLT, STaR and R1 distillation where evaluated, and QwQ distillation in the OpenThoughts comparisons. Sections 4.1 and the baseline-detail appendix describe the same implementations.

E3.justification: Section 4.3 and v1 Appendix B/v2 Appendix A retain the same model configurations, data splits and counts, training budgets, decoding settings and evaluation procedures. Section 6 also retains the 4,096-to-8,192-token budget-forcing intervention.

E4.justification: The sample-order, reflection, prompt-diversity and instruction-prompt ablations are unchanged, as are budget forcing, verification analyses, response-length distributions and example traces. v1 Appendices C and F match v2 Appendices B and E.

E5.justification: Both disclose four evaluation samples for most benchmarks and 34 for GPQA, AIME and AMC, followed by averaging. Table 2 retains the same uncertainty reporting. No run-count, seed or statistical-estimation information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–13 retain their numerical entries, and the figures and qualitative examples retain their findings. For example, Table 1 reports SkillFactory → GRPO Countdown accuracy of 25.1 in both versions; Table 2 retains overall scores of 42.1 and 40.6 for SkillFactory with 1k and 10k examples.

T1.justification: The definitions of retrying, reflection and answer correctness, together with the trace-construction mathematics, are unchanged. Moving Algorithm 1 introduces no new formal reasoning, assumptions, theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about learning cognitive skills from a model's own outputs, improved post-RL generalization, resilience to out-of-domain regression and compatibility with inference-budget scaling.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of SFT versus post-RL performance, the limited benefit of additional SkillFactory SFT data, and structured traces supporting skill transfer. The discussion of lexical-verification weaknesses and model-scale limitations is also unchanged.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, four-GH200 hardware configuration, frameworks, data processing, prompt templates and code/data access statements remain unchanged. The new NVIDIA compute-grant acknowledgment credits support without supplying a different technical configuration or access instruction.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to direct RL, stronger-model distillation, STaR, BOLT and ASTRO remain unchanged. The bibliography is repaginated without substantive additions or removals.

P1.justification: Algorithm 1 moves into Section 3, with its introductory sentence adjusted and appendices B–H renumbered A–G. The header changes from 'Arxiv Preprint' to 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026', and the acknowledgments add an NVIDIA compute grant. Other prose is essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Relocating Algorithm 1 from page 13 to page 4 changes the layout and subsequent text flow. Figure 3 moves from page 4 to page 5, Table 3 from page 8 to page 9, and appendix boxes acquire different page breaks. Table structures and figure designs remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 principally relocates existing pseudocode into the method section and updates publication and funding text. This modest organizational adjustment leaves the scientific explanation, experimental support, limitations and reproducibility information equivalent overall, without a meaningful net change in paper quality.
